title: State OIG evaluates administration of transferred USAID programs
summary: State OIG reported that 17 State Department bureaus and offices were responsible for 1,504 transferred foreign-assistance programs and associated awards with $51.5 billion in obligated value, and documented staffing, training, IT-access, data, and guidance challenges.

sources.title: Evaluation of Department of State Administration of Foreign Assistance Programs Transferred from the U.S. Agency for International Development
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State Office of Inspector General

data.name: State OIG evaluation of administration of USAID programs transferred to State
data.description: AUD-FA-26-17 evaluated State Department administration of USAID foreign-assistance programs and awards transferred in 2025, documenting capacity and implementation challenges and the status of prior recommendations.
